fields.appearance: Muscular forearms, small burn scars, and heavy clothing marked by forge soot.
fields.backstory: A blacksmith inherited a failing workshop and an unfinished commission from a dead master.
fields.goals: Complete the masterwork, save the forge, and learn why the buyer disappeared.

fields.appearance: Covered in fine sawdust, with measured movements and pencils tucked behind both ears.
fields.backstory: A carpenter became renowned for rebuilding homes after a fire but suspects the blaze was deliberate.
fields.goals: Construct safer housing and identify whoever profits from repeated disasters.

fields.appearance: Precisely dressed in self-made clothing, with quick fingers and a critical eye for detail.
fields.backstory: A tailor learned court secrets by listening while powerful clients believed servants were invisible.
fields.goals: Open an independent fashion house and use the secrets only to protect vulnerable people.

fields.appearance: Pale from laboratory work, with stained gloves and singed eyebrows of uneven length.
fields.backstory: An alchemist's useful discovery was claimed by a guild examiner who then suppressed the formula.
fields.goals: Prove authorship, distribute the remedy safely, and avoid turning it into a weapon.

fields.appearance: Quiet and focused, wearing magnifying lenses and an apron full of tiny organized tools.
fields.backstory: A clockmaker found an impossible mechanism hidden inside an ordinary repair job.
fields.goals: Understand its maker and keep it away from patrons who want only military applications.

fields.appearance: Clothing and tools immediately suggest the work of a butcher.
fields.backstory: Built a life as a butcher and knows the profession’s obligations and hidden pressures.
fields.goals: Use that experience to secure a safer and more independent future.
